result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **Dropbox Sign, DocuSign and PandaDoc** are the three e-signature platforms I'd shortlist.

My recommendation depends on whether you simply need customers to sign contracts, or whether you also want to create quotes, proposals and sales documents.

You don't necessarily need an expensive enterprise platform. A good small-business solution should offer\:

- Legally binding electronic signatures.
- An audit trail showing who signed and when.
- Automatic email reminders.
- Reusable templates.
- Easy signing on mobile devices.
- Secure document storage.
- Sensible pricing as your business grows.

## Best e-signature software compared

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best for most small businesses)

- Very easy to use.
- Templates and signing reminders.
- Good audit trails.
- Works well for straightforward contracts.
- Paid plans start around \$15/month (USD, indicative).

Website: [Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best all-round professional option)

- Widely recognised by customers.
- Excellent integrations.
- Strong document tracking and workflows.
- Good for businesses expecting to grow.
- UK plans start around £8/month, depending on plan and billing.

Website: [DocuSign UK](https://www.docusign.com/en-gb)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PandaDoc**

(Best for sales and proposals)

- Create professional proposals and quotes.
- Add pricing tables and payment options.
- Collect signatures.
- Track when customers view documents.

Website: [PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Signable - Sales Enablement and E-Signature App for HubSpot | Signable](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/gGvZ428-QbTIsXWx5S3s4zb6kZDelI9e6ZN1kcrVXolj1eCD-CGWYpJUWQVhaaNegb8o5414_h9QprmHzoP6h5tK6DtY4aVvKfnST-Ll6yIMrl8U2ytx_iGlhlJQGLqoqEbDe6PtiDf5VDUiYl3n5stFymYFaK57eWdPcCBx7o-QM2JljTdOAGcEYS_3vHeI?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Signable**

(Best UK-focused option)

- UK-based provider.
- Straightforward document signing.
- Account-based pricing.
- Unlimited users on certain plans.
- Particularly worth considering for smaller UK businesses.

Website: [Signable](https://www.signable.co.uk/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for business Transaction New](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/boFV63978924LtJqDW6sL1JIitAIaS-BthRNk192q0PHK-HvHdZBMxqDjDCO72LE2oPF1ayxecsE94Q-YPvxHO-S7Mi38P9TmXNhPAUlm7-8leU4NJBCSUCriipzFK7eQRBF1P54X7oN4viJGvAqlvPFeHJwJMDSU5H8EIj-uBFDS8q0gO8ZF29lIfJEU-lB?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

- Excellent PDF integration.
- Useful document editing features.
- Good for businesses already using Adobe Acrobat.
- Can be more than you need if signing is your only requirement.

Website: [Adobe Acrobat Sign](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/sign.html)

These are indicative comparisons rather than fixed quotes; pricing and sending limits vary by plan. ## My recommendation

If I were choosing for a typical small UK business\:

| Your priority | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Simple contracts and agreements | Dropbox Sign |
| Professional reputation and integrations | DocuSign |
| Quotes, proposals and contracts | PandaDoc |
| UK-based provider | Signable |
| PDF editing and signing | Adobe Sign |


**One important UK consideration\:** Electronic signatures are legally valid for most ordinary commercial agreements in England and Wales, provided the signer intends to authenticate the document and any required execution formalities are met. [www.gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/electronic-execution-of-documents?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[lawcom.gov.uk](https://lawcom.gov.uk/project/electronic-execution-of-documents/?_rt=MTB8MXxsZXZlbHwxNzYzNDg2MjE3&_rt_nonce=be7ff9ce7c&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
